findings.description: Generic Protocol declarations are misclassified. For class P(Protocol[T]), the base is ast.Subscript, which _name does not recognize. A declaration such as def save(self): ... is therefore reported as an executable stub. This also affects the identical adapter mirror.
findings.recommendation: Recognize subscripted Protocol bases and add coverage for generic Protocol declarations.

findings.description: Inspection reads the entire target and constructs its AST without a size limit or regular-file check. Progress now invokes this for every Python target, bypassing its existing MAX_READ protection. Large or blocking targets can exhaust memory or stall the command.
findings.recommendation: Bound source reads and reject unsupported file types with an explicit unknown result.

findings.description: The scoped files contain test definitions and verification commands, but no executed results tied to the reviewed inputs. Functional execution evidence is incomplete. No tests were run during this review, as requested.
findings.recommendation: Supply recorded verification results and their input fingerprints.

findings.description: The supplied closure declares no parents and omits runtime dependencies alias_graph, aidd_rules and aidd_evidence. Progress invokes them for alias resolution, batch expansion, evidence stages and read caching. Their behavior and side effects cannot be established within the authorized scope.
